title: Dúo descubierto: el primero sale por casualidad
description: docs/combat.md § Ataques duales (El primero, por casualidad). Two players (two pads faked: the keyboard is Gerard, pad 2 is Aitor) against Vertitrón, Gerard in Matemágico and Aitor in Papagato at level 2, no dual found yet (the tester's help: free maná, no PV lost, unbound so a dual can go off again). Round 1: Gerard aims Foc Binari and Aitor picks Zarpazos in his own dock: nothing is armed, no banner, each just aims their own skill. Aitor confirms: time stops (the scene still, a dark veil, black bars) under «DÚO DESBLOQUEADO · Zarpazos de fuego» with who brought which half, the cost and the description; then it goes off as always. Round 2: now it is found, so the moment Aitor picks Zarpazos with Gerard aiming Foc Binari, both aim the dual with its banner armed, as before. Run it with --gpu.

steps.eval: window.fakePad = i => ({ id: 'Xbox Wireless Controller', index: i, connected: true, mapping: 'standard', timestamp: 0, axes: [0, 0, 0, 0], buttons: Array.from({ length: 17 }, () => ({ pressed: false, value: 0 })) }); window.fakePads = [fakePad(0), fakePad(1)]; navigator.getGamepads = () => window.fakePads; window.ui = window.gerard.battleUI; window.ready = () => ui.fight && ui.fight.phase === 'player' && !ui.fight.busy && !document.querySelector('#battle[data-entering]'); window.pick = (p, sel) => { const el = document.querySelector('.battle-dock[data-dock="' + p + '"] ' + sel); if (p === 1) el.focus(); else for (let i = 0; i < 12 && !el.classList.contains('is-cursor-2'); i++) ui.control('down', 2); ui.control('confirm', p); };
